prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on what you need (realistic presenter vs. quick social reels, budget, languages, brand control, etc.). Below are the top options by use case so you can pick the best fit.

If you want AI presenters / human-like spokespeople
- Synthesia — Highly polished, multilingual AI avatars; good for professional product or explainer ads. Pros: realistic presenters, strong branding controls. Cons: costlier, limited creative video effects.
- HeyGen (Movio/Colossyan are similar) — Faster/cheaper alternatives for realistic talking-head ads.

If you want fast social/video ad templates (best for small businesses & marketers)
- Promo.com — Built specifically for social ads with templates, licensed clips, and ad optimization tools.
- InVideo — Template-driven editor with lots of ad formats and stock media; good balance of control and speed.
- Biteable — Very quick to produce colorful, short ads.

If you’re repurposing long content into short ads
- Pictory — Automatically creates short clips, captions, and social formats from long videos or scripts.

If you need advanced generative/video editing and effects
- Runway — Strong generative tools (text-to-video, background replacement, inpainting) and professional editing features.
- Descript — Excellent for editing via transcript, quick cuts, overdub voice; great for creator-led ads.

If you need subtitles, quick edits, and simple collaboration
- VEED.IO — Good for social ad editing, subtitles, auto-resize for platforms.

If you want e‑commerce ad templates & scale for many SKUs
- Shakr — Templates focused on e‑commerce creative for Facebook/Instagram ads, good for scale and testing.
- Promo.com (again) is also strong for e‑commerce.

If you want data-driven creative optimization
- VidMob — Combines AI signals with human creative optimization for better performing ads (enterprise-focused).

How to choose
- Want a talking head spokesperson? → Synthesia / HeyGen.
- Want the fastest social ad from templates? → Promo.com / InVideo / Biteable.
- Repurposing long content into many short ads? → Pictory.
- Need advanced visual effects / experimental generative video? → Runway.
- Tight budget and basic ads? → Try InVideo, VEED, or Biteable free tiers.

If you tell me: platform (Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/TikTok), budget, ad length, whether you need a human presenter, and whether you have brand assets (logos/voice), I’ll recommend 1–2 best choices and a quick plan to make an ad.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
